title: Pokémon Pokopia
subtitle: Ditto builds a home for other Pokémon
summary: Pokémon Pokopia is a life-simulation and sandbox game co-developed by Game Freak and Omega Force, released for Nintendo Switch 2 on 5 March 2026.
body: Pokémon Pokopia is a life-simulation and sandbox game co-developed by Game Freak and Omega Force, released for Nintendo Switch 2 on 5 March 2026. A Ditto takes a human form and begins restoring a withered world alongside Professor Tangrowth. Collecting materials, making objects and welcoming Pokémon replace the usual Trainer's journey through battles and Gyms. The goal grows from the condition of the place itself: making it more habitable gives other creatures a reason to return and turns an empty landscape into a community.

Ditto learns moves from the Pokémon it befriends and uses them to alter the surroundings. Bulbasaur's Leafage creates greenery, while Squirtle's Water Gun helps dry plants recover. Crafting provides furniture and other objects that can be arranged into useful habitats. Those arrangements attract different residents, whose abilities open further possibilities. The familiar moves acquire another meaning here: their value lies in what they help build, grow or restore, connecting a Pokémon's identity to its contribution to the shared environment.

The day-and-night cycle follows real-world time, changing the atmosphere as the player gathers resources and works on the next improvement. Different Pokémon have their own needs, making observation part of deciding what to create. Omega Force brought experience from Dragon Quest Builders 2 to this collaboration. Pokopia applies that building vocabulary to the pleasure of living among Pokémon: progress becomes visible in the landscape, the homes added to it and the creatures now able to make use of those places.
